articles.title: Light may influence morning basking behaviour in captive gharials
articles.summary: Like all crocodilians, Gangetic gharials regulate their body temperature using external heat sources. They warm their enormous bodies, which can grow to 15 to 20 feet in length, by basking on sandbanks, making it an important daily activity. articles.title: Italian Navy’s Giovanni delle Bande Nere to visit Mumbai from October 18 to 22
articles.summary: The port call forms part of Italy’s Indo-Pacific deployment, with naval engagement and an onboard defence industry presentation scheduled during the visit.

articles.title: Indian Navy inducts indigenous multi-purpose warship Samarthak
articles.summary: Built by L&T at its Kattupalli shipyard with over 75% indigenous content, the multi-purpose vessel will support weapons trials, unmanned systems operations, maritime surveillance and humanitarian missions.
